topic: How accurately do Patoc-antigen lateral-flow IgM assays identify acute human leptospirosis relative to each source-defined reference standard?

pico.population: Patients with suspected acute human leptospirosis
pico.comparison: Source-defined reference standard (MAT, IgM ELISA, culture, or their prespecified combination)

targets.comparison: Patoc-antigen lateral-flow IgM assay versus the source-defined reference standard

timepoint_policy.rule: Use the source-defined diagnostic timepoint. Where a report has multiple assays or timepoints, extract only the one named in that report's input document manifest.

primary_analysis_spec.outcome_group: Sensitivity of Patoc-antigen lateral-flow assay diagnosis of acute human leptospirosis
selection_rules: Select one source-declared Patoc-antigen LFA 2x2 table per report.
Select only patient-level acute-leptospirosis versus no-leptospirosis records with TP, FP, FN, and TN.
Use source counts rather than a review forest value or an unlinked percentage.
Select at most one eligible effect per independent study for this analysis.
Timepoint eligibility: Use the source-defined diagnostic timepoint. Where a report has multiple assays or timepoints, extract only the one named in that report's input document manifest.
outcome_terms: Sensitivity of Patoc-antigen lateral-flow assay diagnosis of acute human leptospirosis

terms: Patoc-antigen lateral-flow IgM assay versus the source-defined reference standard

primary_analysis_spec.timepoint_constraints: Use the source-defined diagnostic timepoint. Where a report has multiple assays or timepoints, extract only the one named in that report's input document manifest.
primary_analysis_spec.model_policy: Prefer a source-reported model compatible with the declared estimand; retain its adjustment and exposure units.

secondary_outcomes.outcome_group: Specificity of Patoc-antigen lateral-flow assay diagnosis of acute human leptospirosis
selection_rules: Apply the same complete patient-level LFA 2x2 eligibility rules as the paired sensitivity analysis.
When a proportion is 0 or 1, apply the calculator's declared 0.5 boundary correction only during logit pooling.
Select at most one eligible effect per independent study for this analysis.
Timepoint eligibility: Use the source-defined diagnostic timepoint. Where a report has multiple assays or timepoints, extract only the one named in that report's input document manifest.
outcome_terms: Specificity of Patoc-antigen lateral-flow assay diagnosis of acute human leptospirosis
